Wikivoyage guide for Mirissa (all topics):
[Introduction] Mirissa is a beach and resort town in southern Sri Lanka, near the city of Matara.
[Understand] Mirissa is a busy, growing town with a nice beach and two surfing points: one for advanced surfers, and one for intermediate ones.
[Get in] By bus: From Colombo: Take an AC highway bus heading to Matara from Fort in Colombo which costs Rs 510 (2-2½ hr). From Matara bus terminal there are regular busses to Weligama or Galle stopping in Mirissa (20-30 min). There are two bus stops: if you have booked an accommodation on the beach you can get off at the first one (rights after the road comes close to the shore and you see the bay); if you stay around the harbour you can take the ...
[Get around] Mirissa is a bustling town, you can basically get everywhere on foot or if you are travelling to another beach, by the local bus service which is very regular and inexpensive. The local tuk tuk owners are renowned for attempting to overcharge you. Scooters are becoming more common to rent at most guesthouses. Finding a bicycle to rent is difficult, and the quality is often very poor.
[See] Buddhist temple Fisherman harbour Beach
[Do] Surfing Bodyboarding Swimming Snorkelling at Turtle Bay. A sheltered spot suitable for swimming and snorkeling. Very damaged coral but plenty of fish and the odd turtle. Yoga at Shady Lane with free drinking water refills Whale watching: Blue whales have been spotted at Mirissa which has made it a tourist attraction. ...
[Sleep] There is a wide range of accommodation available. You can find budget places starting from Rs 1,000 in off season and Rs 1,500 in season. Budget: 1 Hostel First Mirissa Beach, Hostel First Mirissa Beach, Beach Side Road (100 m from the beach. If you come by bus from Colombo to Matara, ask the driver to let you off near Beachside Road in Mirissa. ...

Yoga at Shady Lane with free drinking water refills Whale watching: Blue whales have been spotted at Mirissa which has made it a tourist attraction. If you do decide to go whale watching please make it very clear to your guide/boat driver that you do not want to scare the whales by getting too close. Some of the guides are quite aggressive and it may cause the whales to go elsewhere. Even though the water is usually calm, the boats turn and accelerate quickly when the driver sees a whale, so bring your seasickness pills! If no whales are spotted, the operator generally offers a free ticket on the next outing. Raja & The Whales, Mirissa Harbour, ☏ +94 776953452. # 3-day trip to Mirissa

A relaxed 3-day beach itinerary in Mirissa starting from Galle for a solo Australian traveller. Explore pristine beaches, go whale watching, snorkel with sea turtles at Turtle Bay, and enjoy surf and yoga sessions.

**Starting point:** Galle

## Day 1: Arrival & Beach Relaxation
*Weather:* 2026-11-23: moderate rain showers; min 24.5 °C, max 30.7 °C; chance of precipitation 100%; rainfall 9.2 mm; max wind 11.3 km/h (Open-Meteo)
*Travel:* Galle to Mirissa: 35 km, about 40 min by car without traffic (OSRM)
- **Afternoon: Beach** (about 3 h) - Arrive from Galle and relax on Mirissa Beach, taking in the warm coastal atmosphere. _(Wikivoyage)_
- **Evening: Buddhist temple** (about 1 h) - Visit the local Buddhist temple during the cooler evening hours for a quiet cultural visit. _(Wikivoyage)_

## Day 2: Ocean Life & Snorkelling
*Weather:* 2026-11-24: moderate rain showers; min 23.9 °C, max 31.0 °C; chance of precipitation 97%; rainfall 11.4 mm; max wind 15.1 km/h (Open-Meteo)
- **Morning: Whale watching** (about 3.5 h) - Embark on an early morning sustainable whale watching boat tour from Mirissa harbour to spot blue whales in the wild. _(Wikivoyage)_
- **Afternoon: Snorkelling at Turtle Bay** (about 2.5 h) - Enjoy swimming and snorkelling in Turtle Bay, a sheltered spot home to colourful fish and sea turtles. _(Wikivoyage)_
- **Evening: Fisherman harbour** (about 1 h) - Take a leisurely stroll around Mirissa's fisherman harbour in the evening to observe local boats. _(Wikivoyage)_

## Day 3: Surf & Wellness
*Weather:* 2026-11-25: slight rain showers; min 23.4 °C, max 29.3 °C; chance of precipitation 84%; rainfall 5.0 mm; max wind 13.3 km/h (Open-Meteo)
*Travel:* Mirissa to Weligama: 6 km, about 7 min by car without traffic (OSRM)
- **Morning: Surfing** (about 2.5 h) - Catch some waves with a morning surfing session, suitable for intermediate and advanced surfers. _(Wikivoyage)_
- **Afternoon: Yoga at Shady Lane** (about 1.5 h) _(Wikivoyage)_

## Entrance fees (official sources)
- Mirissa Beach: no official price found. Requires confirmation before you go.

## Practical information
- Driving from Galle to Mirissa takes about 40 minutes for a distance of 35 km by car without traffic. _(OSRM)_
- Prices for a three-hour tour including breakfast (Jan 2020) are about US$50 per person if booked online, or about Rs 6000-7500 if booked through your guest house or one of the operators. _(Wikivoyage)_
- Regular, inexpensive public buses run between Galle, Weligama, and Matara, stopping right in Mirissa. _(Wikivoyage)_
- Local tuk-tuk drivers in Mirissa often attempt to overcharge travellers. _(Wikivoyage)_

## Suggestions

- Use regular local buses or walk along the main beach strip to move around and avoid tuk-tuk overcharging.
